Wu G, Yan J, Yan J. Paper 109-2026.
A side-by-side guide mapping SAS ODS Graphics to R ggplot2, building waterfall, swimmer, Kaplan-Meier, forest, and spider plots in both languages.

Yan J, Wu G, Yan J. Paper 80-2026.

Yan J, Wu G, Yan J. Paper 79-2026.
A centralized R configuration that mirrors SAS autopath conventions, with a version-locked package library and batch/interactive parity.

title: Experience
text:
Senior Manager, Statistical Programming
Kardigan · Princeton, NJ · Jul 2025 – Present

Lead a study programming team delivering SDTM, ADaM, and TLFs for clinical studies
Built BPS_INIT, the standard SAS initialization macro for the programming workspace: detects the program path, derives compound/study/snapshot, creates standard librefs, configures autocall libraries, applies system options, and logs setup status, while staying backward-compatible with existing programs
Tested and validated a centralized R environment and R reporting system running alongside SAS; co-authored two SEASUG 2026 papers on this work



Manager, Statistical Programming
Bristol Myers Squibb · Lawrence, NJ · Apr 2022 – Jul 2025

Led programming deliverables for clinical studies, from SDTM/ADaM through TLFs for CSRs and regulatory submissions
Oversaw timelines, QC, and validation for internal and outsourced programming
Prepared eCTD submission packages, including define.xml, reviewer’s guides, and Pinnacle 21 compliance checks
Mentored programmers and partnered with biostatistics, data management, and clinical teams



Senior Specialist, Programming
Bristol Myers Squibb · Lawrence, NJ · May 2021 – Apr 2022

Programmed and validated SDTM, ADaM, and TLFs in the Statistical Computing Environment (SCE)
Supported submission activities, including CDISC compliance checks and define.xml



Statistical Programmer
Brightech International · Somerset, NJ · Oct 2018 – May 2021

Created SDTM and ADaM datasets and TFLs (RTF, PDF) per specifications and mock shells
Authored SDTM/ADaM specifications and annotated CRFs following CDISC guidelines
Prepared define.xml and SDRG/ADRG with Pinnacle 21 Enterprise for submissions
Performed QC of datasets and displays; supported 3+ concurrent studies and mentored junior programmers
